description: This file contains tests for the TeamInfoView React component, including mocking networking calls, rendering the component in various states, and verifying UI behavior and interaction logic.

classes.name: TeamInfoView
classes.description: React component for displaying and editing team information, tested extensively in this file.

methods.name: should render
methods.description: Test that the TeamInfoView component renders correctly with mocked data and loads expected UI elements.

methods.name: should not show all-proxy-models option when user has no access to it
methods.description: Verifies that the 'All Proxy Models' option does not appear in the dropdown if user lacks access.

methods.name: should only show organization models in dropdown when team is in organization with limited models
methods.description: Checks model dropdown options are limited to organization models when team belongs to an organization with restricted models.

methods.name: should disable secret manager settings for non-premium users
methods.description: Ensures secret manager settings are disabled in the UI for non-premium users.

methods.name: should allow premium users to update secret manager settings
methods.description: Verifies that premium users can edit the secret manager settings and that updates are sent correctly.

methods.name: should include vector stores in object_permission when updating team
methods.description: Checks that vector stores are included in the update payload when editing team info.
